title: Chapter 357 Lin Yao'S Invitation
content:
Chapter 357 Lin Yao'S Invitation

Wang Shuo looked towards the square and saw that the narrow streets were packed with people.

Could it really be a great relic?

Wang Shuo was planning to go to Wang Cuilian's residence to ask.

At this time, Swan just came over in a hurry.

"Hey, Wang Shuo?"

"It's just right, brother Wang, the situation has changed now. Damn, someone among the people we invited before leaked the news. Now all the major forces are ready to move. We must act in advance."

This change directly dispelled most of Wang Shuo's doubts about the authenticity of the relic, and strengthened his idea of trying his luck.

With so many people going, it would be a big loss if he didn't join in the fun.

Swan continued, "Brother Wang, I still have to inform the others. You can go to the gathering place first. When everyone is here, we will set off. If we go too late, I'm afraid we won't have anything to do."

"Okay. Brother Swan, you go ahead. I'll go to the gathering place now."

After Swan left, Wang Shuo was stunned for a while, then walked towards the Treasure Pavilion. He had to be fully prepared.

The news of the ruins was already known to everyone. Wang Shuo was thinking whether to follow a strange big force and fish in troubled waters, or to follow Wang Cuilian and her group.

It was obvious that this kind of scattered team was incomparable to those big forces recruiting people in the square.

After thinking carefully for a while, Wang Shuo figured it out. Following a big force would only mean being cannon fodder.

At this time, the Treasure Pavilion also arrived.

Wang Shuo used all the Shura coins on him to buy recovery pills such as Blood Spirit Pill and Qi Recovery Pill and some necessary exploration supplies.

Affected by the news of the ruins, the prices of these supplies have risen a lot.

Wang Shuo could only accept it.

Walking out of the gate of the Treasure Pavilion, hundreds of generals have gathered in the square outside, and their faces are full of excitement.

As if this is their chance to soar to the sky.

Wang Shuo shook his head. I am afraid that many people will die this time.

Not to mention the danger of the ruins, just the fact that there are too many wolves and too little meat will lead to a fight.

After preparing, Wang Shuo walked towards the gathering place.

"Brother Wang, you came at the right time. Almost all the people I invited this time have arrived."

Wang Cuilian has a very generous personality. As the initiator of this team, he introduced them to everyone one by one.

"This is Ma Yu, this is Lin Yao, this is Wu Jie..."

Wang Shuo just paid a little attention.

Everyone found a place to sit down and waited for the arrival of others.

Half an hour later, Swan came back with the last person.

"Everyone, now that everyone is here, let's set off now."

"Let's make it clear first. This time we have the opportunity to gather together. I hope we can help each other, distribute the spoils equally, and don't fight among ourselves."

Everyone nodded and set off.

Wang Shuo also nodded, but if they really encountered something good, I'm afraid this loose team without even a name would immediately fall into a scramble!

Everyone knew these things, and they all maintained superficial peace.

At this time, a senior general named Lin Yao approached Wang Shuo and whispered: "Brother, I think our team is not very familiar with each other!"

Wang Shuo nodded and glanced at him.

"Brother, don't get me wrong, let me introduce myself again, my name is Lin Yao, you are Wang Shuo!"

"Yes, hello! I don't know what's going on, brother Lin Yao?"

"It's like this, I want to form an alliance with you privately, so many people, at that time, it will definitely be quite chaotic, one more friend to take care of, and one more security guarantee."

Wang Shuo smiled, nodded and agreed: "Okay!"

Anyway, it was a verbal agreement, and he didn't lose anything.

Walking, I saw this Lin Yao approached another teammate again.

You don't need to think about what this guy will say.
